mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_READ = FALSE

SELECT USER_ID AS userId, POLICY_DEADLINE_NOTIFICATION_YN AS policyDeadlineNotificationYn, FINANCIAL_CHANGE_NOTIFICATION_YN AS financialChangeNotificationYn, PLAN_DEVIATION_NOTIFICATION_YN AS planDeviationNotificationYn, SERVICE_NOTICE_NOTIFICATION_YN AS serviceNoticeNotificationYn FROM USER_NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_NOTIFICATION ( USER_ID, POLICY_DEADLINE_NOTIFICATION_YN, FINANCIAL_CHANGE_NOTIFICATION_YN, PLAN_DEVIATION_NOTIFICATION_YN, SERVICE_NOTICE_NOTIFICATION_YN ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{policyDeadlineNotificationYn}, #{financialChangeNotificationYn}, #{planDeviationNotificationYn}, #{serviceNoticeNotificationYn} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE POLICY_DEADLINE_NOTIFICATION_YN = #{policyDeadlineNotificationYn}, FINANCIAL_CHANGE_NOTIFICATION_YN = #{financialChangeNotificationYn}, PLAN_DEVIATION_NOTIFICATION_YN = #{planDeviationNotificationYn}, SERVICE_NOTICE_NOTIFICATION_YN = #{serviceNoticeNotificationYn}
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET IS_READ = TRUE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_READ = FALSE
